in_sanskrit.name: Babu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Father, elder brother
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Babu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Baba’, meaning ‘father’ or ‘elder brother’. In Hinduism, it is also used as a title of respect for an elderly person or a guru. The name Babu carries a sense of wisdom, respect, and authority.
